validity.researcher_notes: Confirmed via OPEC ASB Table 4.10, cross-checked across TWO separate editions recovered from Wayback + pdftotext (opec.org's live PDFs are dead, redirecting to the homepage -- this is the exact gotcha the protocol flags): ASB2012 (2011 data) lists 'Bu-Attifel/Intesar, Mellitah Oil and Gas, 133, 34in, 11,328,236'; ASB2013 (2012 data) lists the same route as '82.46' under a column genuinely in miles (82.46 x 1.609 = 132.7 km). Both independently converge on ~132-133 km, matching the sheet's existing 131.96 km closely (within the normal edition-to-edition/rounding drift also seen on other rows in this cluster -- see P1856/P1857 for the full explanation of why ASB2012's 'miles'-headed column is actually already in km, confirmed against the well-documented 540 km Greenstream pipeline in the same table). This is strong, source-diverse corroboration (two ASB editions, both consistent with each other and with the sheet) that 131.96 km is correct. The drawn geometry (91.4 km, a near-straight line between the two field centroids) undercounts the true corridor by about 30% -- consistent with being a schematic/endpoints-only trace rather than a traced real route, exactly as the brief's context anticipated. Per the standing rule about a flagged disagreement being a question not a verdict: here the LENGTH is the well-evidenced value and the ROUTE is the partial/schematic item -- the opposite conclusion from P1856/P1860/P1861 in this same cluster.
